items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: can hear Miles’s influence from Freddie Webster.

ctx.x: I saw him play twice. I saw him play that Sunday. His sound was like a big red ball, if you could imagine a guy with a trumpet like you’d blow a bubble from a bubble gum. You see a huge, shiny, red, beautiful ball come out of the front of his horn. Beautiful sound. Different than Fats or anybody. I heard him play like that. And then I heard him in Dizzy’s band the first time I heard Bird with Dizzy up at the McKinley Theater. He was in that band. I heard him play that day. Yeah, he was incredible. And I
can hear Miles’s influence from Freddie Webster. I can hear it. It’s very obvious that Miles was totally absorbed by Freddie’s playing, as well as Dizzy.
Tell now – I took you off, but tell us how the rest of that day unfolded.
